title: Promotion
description: Marketing promotion or sale campaign offering percentage discounts. Contains promotion details, discount percentage, active period, and status for promotional campaigns.

title.description: Promotional title or campaign name (e.g., Summer Sale, Black Friday, Holiday Special)

description.description: Detailed description of the promotion, terms, and eligible products

start_date.description: Date when the promotion becomes active

active.description: Whether the promotion is currently active and available
